messages.content:
Inspect command outcomes.

## Model-family guidance (InfCode production contract)
- Family: default
- - Be concise, direct, and action-oriented; minimize narration outside tool use.
- Inspect relevant files before editing and prefer the smallest change that solves the task.
- Use tools for software-engineering work, verify changes, and report only the relevant outcome.
- Do not invent URLs, repository facts, command output, or verification evidence.

## Available skills
- **code-review**: Code review checklist and best practices

<context-injection>
Recalled background memory, runtime state, and working memory for this turn. Treat as context, not as a new user request.
ProjectProfile: languages=none; package_managers=none; tests=none; typecheck=none; source_roots=none; test_roots=none
<system-reminder>
- Turn 1/2 | task_complexity=L0 | task_mode=discuss | 1 turns remaining
</system-reminder>
<repo-routing>
Retrieval routing: exact literal -> grep_search; exact symbol -> repo_context symbol_context or LSP; unknown structural location -> repo_context lookup; changed-code reasoning -> changed_scope/impact. Business-language intent with vocabulary mismatch: start broad with repo_context lookup or grep variants.
</repo-routing>

<repo-routing>
Repository intelligence did not provide bounded evidence (no-high-confidence-candidates). Use repo_context, grep_search, or read_file for precise verification; this is not evidence that the repository has no match.
</repo-routing>
</context-injection>

Inspect the command outcome and explain it. Do not modify files.

function.name: apply_patch
function.description: Apply exact text replacements, file creates, and file deletes atomically. Validates every hunk before writing and returns diffs. Every change must include its relative path.

path.description: Compatibility fallback for saved single-file calls; new calls must set path on every change.

op.description: Patch operation. Default: replace. Use append only to add new content at end-of-file without old_text.

old_text.description: Exact text to replace, or delete guard text.

overwrite.description: Allow op=create to replace an existing file.

dry_run.description: Preview diffs without writing files. Default: false.

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a shell command in the workspace. Use for running tests, installing packages, git operations, etc.

workdir.description: Workspace-relative directory in which to run the command. Use this instead of cd. Defaults to the workspace root.

function.name: compact
function.description: Manually compress the conversation context to free up space.

function.name: diff_status
function.description: Show current git diff status: which files changed, diff size, whether tests were modified, and whether to verify/finalize or keep searching.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace exact text in a file (first occurrence only). old_text must match exactly once.

old_text.description: The exact text to find and replace. Must be unique in the file.

function.name: emit_handoff
function.description: Transfer this run to a declared Agent role after the current tool batch settles, or emit terminal=true when this terminal role is complete.

function.name: glob_search
function.description: Find files matching a glob pattern (e.g. '**/*.py', 'src/**/*.ts'). Results are sorted by modification time, most recent first.

path.description: Directory to search in. Omit to use the workspace root.

function.name: grep_search
function.description: Search file contents with regex. Default mode returns matching lines grouped by absolute file path and sorted by file modification time. Use output_mode='files_with_matches' for paths only, or 'count' for counts. NEVER use bash grep/rg — always use this tool for search.

path.description: Directory to search in. Default: workspace root.

include.description: File glob filter, e.g. '*.py'. Default: all files.

output_mode.description: Output mode. 'content' (default) shows matching lines. 'files_with_matches' shows paths. 'count' shows per-file matching-line counts.

head_limit.description: Max results. Default: 100 (content) or 50 (files/count). Use 0 for unlimited.

offset.description: Skip first N results for pagination. Default: 0.

context.description: Lines of context around matches (content mode only). Default: 0.

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List files and directories in a path. Use depth to control recursion.

function.name: load_skill
function.description: Load specialized domain knowledge or workflow instructions by skill name. Check the available skills list in the system prompt before calling.

function.name: mcp_catalog
function.description: Search MCP servers, tools, prompts, and resources without exposing every schema; then fetch one exact prompt or resource from the active MCP runtime.

function.name: process
function.description: Start and control a persistent long-running process across Agent turns. Use this, not bash, for dev servers, watch mode, REPLs, and live logs. Operations: start, read by byte cursor, write stdin, status/list, resize, kill.

process_id.description: Exact stable proc_* ID returned by start. Never invent an alias. Omit for status/list of all Session processes.

append_newline.description: Append a newline to write data.

cursor.description: Read from this byte cursor; use next_cursor on later reads. -1 starts at current end.

tail_bytes.description: When cursor is omitted, read only this many tail bytes.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to 30 seconds for new output without killing the process.

tty.description: Request a PTY on POSIX; Windows uses persistent pipes.

function.name: question
function.description: Ask the user 1-4 structured questions only when a material decision cannot be resolved from the request, repository, or sensible defaults. Put a recommended choice first and suffix its label with '(Recommended)'. Users may type a custom answer, so do not add an Other option.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read file contents with line numbers. Use offset/limit for large text or converted PDF/DOCX files. PDF page ranges use pages="5" or pages="1-10" with at most 20 pages per request.

limit.description: Number of lines to read. Default: 2000.

pages.description: PDF page range, for example "5" or "1-10". Maximum 20 pages per request.

function.name: read_scratchpad
function.description: Read all entries in your working memory scratchpad. The scratchpad is also shown automatically each turn; only call this explicitly if you need the full untruncated history.

function.name: read_tool_result
function.description: Read a bounded chunk of a persisted tool result by its opaque artifact ID. Only artifacts owned by the current Session are accessible.

function.name: replace_lines
function.description: Replace a 1-based inclusive line range in a file. Use after read_file shows exact line numbers, especially when exact-text edits are brittle.

new_text.description: Replacement text for the line range.

function.name: repo_context
function.description: Query persistent lexical/structural repository intelligence: overview, module dependencies/dependents, unified structural intent lookup, symbol/process call contexts, dependency cycles, or changed scope.

function.name: review_run_evidence
function.description: Inspect the current Agent's Runtime-owned evidence and unresolved requirements. Call with no arguments; do not supply files, commands, or verification claims. Read-only advisory review; normal completion and semantic review still apply.

function.name: send_message
function.description: Send a non-blocking coordinator instruction to a live child Agent by session id or display name, or use '*' for a bounded broadcast.

to.description: Live child session id, display name, or '*'.

content.description: Actionable instruction that changes the child's plan.

seen_by.description: Forwarding chain copied from a received message.

function.name: task
function.description: Spawn or resume a child-agent session with isolated context and its own worktree. Returns either a final summary or a parent handoff request.

prompt.description: Task description or follow-up reply for the child agent.

agent_type.description: explore = cheap read-only repo scan, plan = parent-model read-only implementation design, general-purpose = parent-model full-tool worker in its own worktree, reflection = read-only completion critic. Default: explore.

session_id.description: Existing child session id to resume after the child asked the parent for help.

allowed_tools.description: Optional allowlist to narrow the child's tool scope.

target_paths.description: Optional repo-relative files or directories this child will own. Use for write-capable tasks to prevent overlapping edits with other active child sessions.

output_schema.description: Optional supported JSON-Schema subset for a validated structured child result.

model_hint.description: Semantic child model tier; unavailable tiers explicitly inherit the parent route.

evidence_refs.description: Bounded file:/diff:/finding:/task_id: evidence references injected into the child briefing.

verification.description: Machine-checkable child postconditions: enforcement, mutation/read/path/final-text requirements.

function.name: todo
function.description: Update the session task list. Keep one item in_progress. Use for multi-step work.

items.description: Complete list of todo items (replaces any previous list).

function.name: tool_search
function.description: Discover tools hidden by progressive schema exposure, including workflow, project creation, memory, advanced repository intelligence, web, MCP/LSP, planning, and orchestration capabilities. Use select:TOOL_NAME for an exact schema or descriptive keywords; matching tools are unlocked for the next model turn in this Session only.

function.name: update_scratchpad
function.description: Record session working notes. Prefer category='plan' for the active plan or confirmed facts, and category='failure' for failed attempts or verification failures.

category.description: plan: active plan or important confirmed fact; failure: what failed and why

content.description: Your note. Keep it concise (max 500 chars).

function.name: verify_changed_files
function.description: Run low-noise language-aware checks on changed source files: Python py_compile, JS/TS typecheck when configured, Go package check, and Rust cargo check. Excludes test files by default.

include_tests.description: Include changed test files. Default: false.

timeout.description: Per-file timeout in seconds. Default: 30, max: 120.

function.name: verify_project_build
function.description: Run safe low-noise verification commands for a generated project directory without installing dependencies.

project_dir.description: Project directory relative to the workspace.

commands.description: Optional explicit verification commands. If omitted, common commands are inferred.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates parent directories if needed. Overwrites existing content.

function.name: write_files_batch
function.description: Write multiple files atomically. Validates every path before writing, blocks credential-like files, and fails the entire batch if any file conflicts.

purpose.description: Optional short description for the file.

overwrite.description: Allow overwriting existing files. Default: false.
